name: Employee offboarding and handover checklist
summary: When someone leaves, your HR lead and their manager share one checklist: every piece of their work handed to a named colleague before the last day, every system on your access register removed by its owner at a set time, and every item of equipment back. Nothing is removed or sent without a person.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work, and the export form of this one: the company's access register and equipment list as the only authority, stated column headers with a stop when one does not match, a flag and a question for a named role for every gap, the reason for leaving and sign-in details kept out, and nothing removed, moved or sent until a person approves.

sources.contribution: A written handover owned by the departing person and reviewed by the manager, completed early in the notice period; the topics it covers, including unwritten know-how; a recorded removal for every system; device return and wiping, mail forwarding and shared-account changes; separate HR, IT and manager steps with owners and dates; team told at an agreed time; gaps flagged for the manager; termination letters left to qualified people.
